summary: Historical Python plugin contract. Current Hermes integration uses native Shin2.0 MCP and its workflow skill; Core stays agent-neutral and consumer AGENTS.md and adoption contracts retain authority.

ownership.shin: Deterministic project discovery, route validation, freshness, retrieval, diagnostics, and Agent Context Pack semantics.
ownership.hermes: Agent session, model routing, tool invocation, skills, delegation, and optional automation.
ownership.consumer: Product source, tests, accepted decisions, machine contracts, adoption marker, and AGENTS.md authority.

tools.name: shin_discover_project
tools.role: Read-only cold-start discovery for an unknown repository.

tools.name: shin_ready_context
tools.role: Strict adopted-route, publication, worktree, and quality readiness.

tools.name: shin_pack_context
tools.role: Readiness-gated compact multi-requirement Agent Context Pack.

tools.name: shin_diagnose_context
tools.role: Expected-path retrieval diagnosis after strict readiness.

tools.name: shin_suggest_profile
tools.role: Explicit reviewed routing-contract recommendation without automatic switching.

toolset.corePayloadRule: The adapter preserves each Shin JSON result under result and adds route, process, readiness, remediation, and adapter version fields without changing Core schemas.

nonGoals: No second ranking implementation in the adapter.
No implicit model inference, source execution, or telemetry upload.
No claim that tool output alone completes a task.

currentIntegration.runtime: native shin-mcp with shin_status, shin_query, shin_inspect and shin_read
currentIntegration.boundary: Hermes owns conversation and compression; Shin owns verified project evidence, not chat memory.
currentIntegration.plugin: The Python plugin below is retained compatibility source, not the default client route.

installation.contractResolution: Workflow instructions resolve machine contracts from the Core binary layout: <shin-home>/docs/machine for source checkouts or <prefix>/share/shin-context/contracts for installed distributions. They do not traverse relative paths into a sibling Codex skill or assume this skill's global installation depth.
installation.mutationPolicy: The installed local skill is replaceable delivery output; the plugin-bundled workflow remains the canonical read-only source.

profileRegistryOrder: consumer-owned profile registry when the adopted project provides one
routeResolution.indexRule: Use explicit out_dir or SHIN_CONTEXT_CACHE_DIR. Otherwise select exactly one published index matching marker index.key from XDG cache or a resolved Shin source build/context tree.
routeResolution.ambiguityPolicy: Multiple markers or multiple published indexes fail closed and require an explicit path.

transport.stderr: one independently byte-bounded diagnostic stream; raw child stderr is never exposed

resultValidation.descriptorSource: Each adapter call site supplies the expected Core command and schema; transport never infers either from argv.
resultValidation.jsonDecoding: Both streams use strict JSON decoding: duplicate object keys and non-finite numbers are rejected. stdout and stderr are independently checked against maxOutputBytes before JSON parsing.
resultValidation.successEnvelope: A result is accepted only when schema_version, tool, command, and a real JSON boolean ok match the supplied descriptor. Missing fields, wrong types, mismatched identity, and a successful result with a nonzero process exit fail closed.
resultValidation.stderrErrorEnvelope: When stdout is empty, transport accepts stderr only as one shin.error.v1 document whose tool, command, ok=false, documented error fields, and exit_code match the supplied descriptor and process exit. Its documented error metadata is preserved; raw child stderr is not exposed as an adapter log channel.
resultValidation.failurePolicy: Malformed or mismatched stdout and stderr envelopes return INVALID_SHIN_OUTPUT without reflecting arbitrary child payloads.

projectIntegration.sessionRecovery: The workflow skill invokes checkpoint/resume through the resolved Core CLI route. No new plugin tool or automatic compaction hook is claimed. Session state stays in external host-owned storage; see session-checkpoint-v1.json.
projectIntegration.reason: Hermes already loads the existing AGENTS.md hierarchy; adding .hermes.md would create a competing higher-priority project instruction route.
projectIntegration.recommendedFirstMode: Read-only readiness, Brief, Pack, diagnostics, and review.
